feat(entries): list the electricity explainer

## Intent

List the electricity explainer in the catalog, as the last step of a second full creator run that tests the explainer archetype on a physics topic for the younger grades, from /apps/build/ to the catalog. The app is live.

## Key changes

- A catalog entry for Elektrizität: Physik for Klasse 5 and 6, at https://lernapps.net/elektrizitaet/, in German and English.
- Eight topics link the pages: simple circuit, conductors and insulators, switches and circuit symbols, series and parallel circuits, the circuit editor, effects of electric current, safe handling.
- Fitness: no account, no install, no storage, no third parties.
